Field/Scenario: outstandingBalance equal to zero (loan fully paid off)
Test Steps: 1. Set outstandingBalance=0. 2. Save. 3. Observe computed status.
Expected Result: Computed status field transitions to CLOSED (per code: signum()==0 -> CLOSED); net worth impact from this record becomes 0 (nothing subtracted).

Field/Scenario: outstandingBalance negative (overpayment/credit balance edge case)
Test Steps: 1. Set outstandingBalance to a negative value (credit card overpaid). 2. Save.
Expected Result: status computed as ACTIVE (signum() != 0 since negative is non-zero); net worth calculation would subtract a negative balance, effectively ADDING to net worth — verify this edge case is either handled explicitly (clamped to 0) or documented as a known quirk since a negative outstanding balance should logically not increase net worth via a liability module.

Field/Scenario: outstandingBalance exceeds creditLimit (over-limit scenario)
Test Steps: 1. Set outstandingBalance greater than creditLimit. 2. Submit.
Expected Result: Record saves (no hard block expected in schema) but UI should visually flag over-limit status (e.g., warning badge) since outstandingBalance > creditLimit is a real-world risk indicator; verify app surfaces this appropriately.

Field/Scenario: outstandingBalance equal to creditLimit exactly (fully utilized)
Test Steps: 1. Set outstandingBalance = creditLimit. 2. Submit.
Expected Result: Record saves; represents 100% utilization; no error, but ideally flagged as at-limit.

Field/Scenario: tenureMonths exceeded relative to startDate (loan overdue, monthsRemaining should clamp to 0)
Preconditions: On add form, loanType=HOME_LOAN with startDate far in the past and short tenureMonths
Test Steps: 1. Set startDate many months ago and tenureMonths less than elapsed months. 2. Save. 3. Observe monthsRemaining.
Test Data: loanType=HOME_LOAN, startDate=2015-01-01, tenureMonths=60 (elapsed months from 2015-01-01 to 2026-07-08 is far more than 60)
Expected Result: monthsRemaining computed as Math.max(0, tenureMonths - elapsed) = 0, NOT a negative number; loan should visually indicate it is past its expected tenure even though outstandingBalance may still be non-zero.

Field/Scenario: tenureMonths exactly equal to elapsed months (monthsRemaining = 0 boundary)
Test Steps: 1. Set startDate and tenureMonths such that elapsed months == tenureMonths exactly. 2. Save.
Test Data: loanType=CAR_LOAN, startDate=2021-07-08, tenureMonths=60 (elapsed = 60 months as of 2026-07-08)
Expected Result: monthsRemaining computed as 0; status remains ACTIVE if outstandingBalance still > 0 (status is independent of monthsRemaining).

Field/Scenario: principalAmount / outstandingBalance equal to zero at creation

Expected Result: Record saves; status computed as CLOSED immediately (outstandingBalance signum 0); questionable business scenario (a loan with zero principal) should be flagged for review but not hard-blocked.
